measured.caption: Measured 2026-11-23 on nanocodec development build 1da4349e, plain (crate version 0.6.0) for our browser module (relaxed SIMD); built as 3d37138a, the same source before rebase. AWS c8a.large (AMD EPYC 9R45, Zen 5), one thread pinned to one physical core (CPU 1), node v22.21.1, both modules in the same 7 interleaved rounds (tools/web/ffmpeg_wasm_yardstick.py); the codec calls alone on both sides (ours the decode() and encode() calls, ffmpeg.wasm its decode_video and encode_video calls by -benchmark_all), no module start-up, probing, demuxing or command parsing; encode at the same rate limits on both sides (600 kbps target, 1200 kbps peak, 600 kbit buffer). References: ffmpeg.wasm (@ffmpeg/core 0.12.10: FFmpeg 5.1.4 and x264 under emscripten, one thread, --disable-asm with -O3 -msimd128: compiler-generated SIMD128 only, FFmpeg's and x264's hand-written SIMD off).
